title: Hesamation paraphrases FreeToken as an unnamed Berkeley/MIT engine
summary: Hesamation paraphrases FreeToken (quoted Andy_ShuoYang / 2090856976880472439) as an unnamed Berkeley/MIT engine. DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B at 25 tok/s is the top of FreeToken’s 22–25 tok/s 5090 band. MIT is only in this paraphrase. Same engine as must-read x-2091150763418620133.
question_it_answers: Which engine is the unnamed Berkeley/MIT inference tweet actually pointing at?

claims.text: The engine runs DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B at 25 tok/s on an RTX 5090 system.
claims.evidence: > runs DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B at 25 tok/s with a RTX 5090 system
claims.subject: local-inference-models

claims.text: Reported 1.46× faster than llama.cpp on the same test; Ollama cannot serve that model.
claims.evidence: > 1.46x faster than llama.cpp on the same test. Ollama can’t even serve it
claims.subject: local-inference-models

claims.text: Quoted tweet 2090856976880472439 is Andy_ShuoYang announcing FreeToken. Same engine as x-2091150763418620133. DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B → 5090 @ 22–25 tok/s; Hesamation’s 25 tok/s is the top of that band.
claims.evidence: Andy_ShuoYang: Meet FreeToken. DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B → RTX 5090 desktop @ 22-25 tok/s. Hesamation quotes the tweet and writes 25 tok/s.
claims.subject: local-inference-models

claims.text: MIT is only in Hesamation’s paraphrase. FreeToken authors on the paper/NOTES are Berkeley / UT / others. Repo FlashML-org/FreeToken, Apache-2.0.
claims.evidence: Hesamation: UC Berkeley + MIT researchers. FreeToken NOTES: Authors Berkeley / UT / others (Stoica, Zaharia, Han). Repo Apache-2.0.
